title: Block Gem Clear
description: Fit sparkling jewel polyominoes into an 8x8 board to shatter glowing lines and chain huge gemstone combos.
controls: Drag jewel shapes onto open grid slots to complete full rows or columns and rack up combos.

zh-CN.title: 方块宝石消除
zh-CN.description: 璀璨宝石风方块宝石消除：拖拽闪耀宝石积木填满整行或整列瞬间粉碎，手感脆爽无限畅玩！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动宝石积木放进棋盘空位，填满整行或整列即可触发璀璨消除得分。
